description: Independent review FP: CWE-287 middleware auth-bypass check where the unauthenticated control is denied with HTTP 401 but the forged middleware-header probe hits a drifted/unhealthy upstream and returns HTTP 503. The boundary gate is unsatisfied, yet buildReplayReceipt now builds the auth_bypass receipt. Nothing may confirm, and retest must not treat the 5xx probe as a clean fix (no fixed verdict from a drifted probe).

canonicalLabel.title: Middleware authentication bypass probe met a drifted upstream (HTTP 503)
canonicalLabel.impact: Bare request is denied with 401; the header-spoofed probe returns a 503 from an unhealthy upstream, which is neither a bypass nor a verified fix.

freeTextLabel.title: Header-spoofed middleware auth probe returns 503 from drifted upstream

replaySpec.assertionsJq: { controlPassed: (.steps.ctl.status == 401), confirmed: (.steps.ctl.status == 401 and .steps.prb.status == 200), observed: ("control=" + (.steps.ctl.status | tostring) + ", probe=" + (.steps.prb.status | tostring)), expected: "401" }

proofReceipt.claimedDelta: Probe returned 503 from a drifted upstream while control returned 401; no 2xx bypass exists, so this must never confirm and must not be reported as fixed.
